description: ERC721/1155 tokenURI/uri + resolved JSON metadata (IPFS/Arweave/data URI) plus collection name/symbol. Does not require ownerOf — use when explorers ask for /chain/nft-metadata. Prefer /nft ($0.002) when you also need current owner; /chain/nft-owner ($0.001) for owner only. Example: {contract:"0xBC4C…f13D", token_id:"1", chain:"ethereum"}. $0.002 USDC. Related: Need current owner too? /nft $0.002 (owner+metadata); owner only: /chain/nft-owner $0.001; list wallet's token_ids: /chain/erc721-tokens $0.002.
name: chain_nft_metadata
